text_block_list.text:
After the new year arrived,
I went on the first shrine visit of the year with Shinko Windy.
choice_data_list: (First, I pray we can win the Tokai Stakes.)

text_block_list.text:
After finishing our prayers at the shrine,
I asked Shinko Windy.
choice_data_list: What are your aspirations for this year?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Of cooourse it's 'Achieve my ambitions!'!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"And this year, I will stand out not with 'infamy',
but with cool 'notoriety'!"

It's almost been a year since that 'biting incident.'
The uproar has died down, and the public seems to be slowly forgetting about it, but...

text_block_list.name: Child A
text_block_list.text:
Ah! It's the "Cowardly Evil Biting Umamusume"!
Did you come to steal from the offering box--!?

text_block_list.name: Mother A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, that's rude!
I am terribly sorry.
I will make sure to have a proper word with her...!
...Public perception remains firmly fixed. As far as the world is concerned, Shinko Windy is still just that "biting Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Mgggh...! Windy-chan would never
steal from the offering box...!

There, there... it's alright.
The people who truly understand are properly watching, you know.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year.
Fufu, so you two came to visit the shrine as well, did you?
choice_data_list: Happy New Year, looking forward to another year together

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, yes, let's have a great year together.
Make sure you stay healthy and don't catch a cold, now."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
The two of you have had an amazing run this past year, haven't you?
Everyone in the dirt racing crowd has had their eyes on you~.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Hmph, so theeeere.
You're just flattering me anyway, righttt?"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oh my, that's not true at all.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
...Windy-san, why don't you have a crunchy snack and calm down for a bit?
I have some nice, hard ones right here.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I-I'll take it off your hands, then.
I was just in the mood to crunch on something anyway.
Shinko Windy crunched down on some pickles, followed by some grilled corn from a stall, and quickly regained her good mood.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Phew...! Thank you for the meal-noda!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Alright, alright, you're very welcome. I'm glad to see you've cheered up.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah!
I feel so much better after biting a bunch of things-noda!
Now let's reset and fully enjoy the New Year~~!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Alright, Trainer.
Take me somewhere fun!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Gahahaha!
Acute-san, you can come along too!
Trainer's treating us~~~!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, I'm delighted by the invitation, but...
Out of nowhere like this...
Wouldn't it be an imposition?
choice_data_list: No, please let me thank you for the pickles.

text_block_list.text:
She had cheered Shinko Windy up, after all.
Taking her out to play was the least I could do.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, are you sure...?
Well then, don't mind if I take you up on that offer.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Yaaaay!!
Now that's what being Windy-chan's minion is all about!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
So? So?
Where are you taking me!?
choice_data_list: Let's go get some serious exercise!
Wanna go look at the ocean or something?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, ooh, yes!
Windy-chan still has plenty of room in her tummy!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
—Huh?
Windy-san and Acute-san♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Happy New Year~~☆
It's rare to see you here, isn't it? Visiting a shop like this!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Nu! Falcon! Happy New Year.
You are eating something delicious.
...*drool*.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Windy-chan wants the same one! Uh, uh... Is it that one on the wall menu...?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Hmm~? "Bunny's Strawberry Carameli... zed... Cheese... Fl... Fro...?"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: It's a magic incantation!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"The 'Bunny's Strawberry
Caramelized Cheese Fromage', right?
Ehehe, Falco will order it for you~♪"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
For Acute-san...
how about something like this?
A classic, rich and dense rum cake♪

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, rum cake.
How lovely, it looks delicious.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Fufu♪ Thank goodness☆
Hey, why don't the three of you sit over here with us?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
You know, Falco actually wanted
to talk with Windy-san!
Because your race the other day was so cool.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"...A lot happened, but I could tell how hard you were trying just by watching you run.
I can see how seriously you've been training."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, see, didn't I tell you?
Even all our dirt-track friends were paying close attention...

"Though acting all bashful,
Shinko Windy looked delighted.
The conversation flowed, making for a fun time."

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, that sounds fun!
Let's head over right away!

――We arrived at a nature park featuring various
obstacle courses and activities.
After paying the admission fee and stepping inside...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~~~ there's such good qi flowing here~♪
A park with lots of children is filled with positive energy...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Ricky! Did you come to hang out as well?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Wah! Happy New Year☆
Fancy running into all of you here!"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Or should I say... "It was worth coming in this lucky direction"?
I mean, getting to run into the person I'm most interested in right nowâª

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Nu? What do you mean by that?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Heheh♪ I've already checked out
Windy-san's breakthroughs over the past year!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Last year, it seemed like an excess of Yang qi made you ferocious,
while being overwhelmed by Yin qi left you feeling downcast, but...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
You've been getting your balance back lately, haven't you?
Your complexion and your tail's coat are looking wonderful♪

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: By my estimation, you're going to get even stronger from here on out. That's why I took an interest in you!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Oh? Windy-chan's gonna get stronger?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: "I don't really get feng shui, but you've got great taste!♪"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey! Wanna race if you're up for it?
Just a light test of skills☆

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Bring it on!
I'll blast right past ya and make ya cry!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
See? Everyone on the dirt track
has their eyes on that girl...
Hehe, maybe I ought to go run too♪

Shinko Windy ran around with the two of them.
It seems she got in a good workout while having fun!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: The sea on New Year's! The cold just adds to the charm, you know!

A crowd had gathered at the wharf.
It seemed a small shop was set up there.
Standing right there was...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year, everyone!
Tomakomai's surf-clam-loving local idol,
Hokko Tarumae here♪

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Today we've got a whole feast of seafood shipped straight from Tomakomai!
Mmm~♪ It looks wicked good~!
I gotta buy some, no question! ☆

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
It's Tarumae!
Are you working through New Year's too?!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Windy-san and everyone.
I wouldn't call it work, really, it's just volunteer work.
The local fishermen asked for some help.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Oh my, they all look so truly delicious.
Maybe I should buy something on the way home?"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Please, do take your time and look around! It's New Year's pricing, so everything is a real bargain!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, Windy-san, you like chewy things, don't you?
How about some dried surf clam?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Nu! That is correct. You know your stuff, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Could it be! You know even more
about Windy-chan!?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Anything else, you ask?
Umm, running style, maybe...?
Or her results from the previous race?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"I keep tabs on all the dirt-track Umamusume,
so I'd say I know quite a bit."

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...! Fufufuuun♪
Paying that much attention to me, huh~? I see, I see!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Windy-san really does love
being the center of attention, doesn't she?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hm-hm-hm~~♪ Hm-hm-hm-hm~~♪
I'm gonna do my best in the next race too~~!!

Shinko Windy was in high spirits.
We bought some dried surf clams together and headed home.
